name: koenote
description: 会議・セミナーの長時間文字起こしを行い、マイGPTへ渡す準備を整えるデスクトップアプリ
author: hashimoto

scripts.dev:electron: npm run build:electron && wait-on http://localhost:5173 && cross-env NODE_ENV=development electron .
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build:electron && npm run build:renderer
scripts.test:backend: cd backend && "$(node -e "const fs=require('fs');const v='../.venv/bin/python';process.stdout.write(fs.existsSync(v)?v:'python3')")" -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_*.py'
scripts.package:backend: rm -rf backend/packaging/build backend/packaging/dist && "$(node -e "const fs=require('fs');const v='./.venv/bin/python';process.stdout.write(fs.existsSync(v)?v:'python3')")" -m PyInstaller --noconfirm --clean --distpath backend/packaging/dist --workpath backend/packaging/build backend/packaging/koenote_backend.spec
scripts.package:mac: npm run package:backend && npm run build && electron-builder --mac --arm64

extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: 録音して文字起こしを行うためにマイクを使用します。
